en:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.
FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.
Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!
{PLAYER} received TM38\nfrom BLAINE.
TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.
Make space for this, child!
Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?
Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!
Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…
I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.
I surrender!
I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.
I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!
Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!
My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.
I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.
Too hot to handle!
I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!
I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.
Ow!

Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.
I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.
Yowza!\nToo hot!
PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.
Fire is weak against H2O.
Oh!\nSnuffed out!
Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.
{PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!
CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}

POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!
CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?
There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?
POLIWAG evolves three times?
Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?
POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?
TM28 contains TOMBSTONY?
You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!
Sorry!\nBad call!
